cohort: The study analyzed data from 3296 general surgical patients from the RIETE registry who developed symptomatic postoperative VTE within the first 8 weeks after noncancer surgery.
finding: The median time from noncancer surgery to VTE detection was 16 days, with 77% of VTE events detected after the first postoperative week and 27% after 4 weeks, indicating a persistent high risk for up to two months.
followup_time: Up to 90 days (for death), with primary VTE focus on the first 8 weeks after surgery.
